[b]The Eastern Strait
11:56am HST+7[/b]
The sound of the peaceful sea fills the air in the eastern strait, but the minds of the sailors are far from peaceful. The sky may be clear now, but soon it will be filled with black smoke and missile trails. The 7th, 8th, 9th, 11th, 12th and 13th fleets bob up and down in the water, blocking the entire strait, awaiting the Sal-Baliz. At 11:56am, a lookout spots the enemy through their binoculars. The naval forces burst into life in an instant, however there is still no sign of the Italian-Dutch navy. Missiles aimed, ships sent forward, helicopters overhead. The first attack comes quickly. Norrhollower made missiles streak through the sky towards the Hydronians.
[i]*BANG* *BANG*[/i]
Two are shot out of the sky, but one gets through the armada of AA fire and hits a small patrol boat. A larger ship immediately swerves towards it and begins to drag it away to safety. In an instant, the Hydronian Navy opens fire, filling the air with a chilling din. Water splashes everywhere as bullets and missiles fire through the strait.

[i][b]May the Battle of The Eastern Strait commence[/b][/i]

[i]More posts coming soon[/i]
